title: McpTestPayload
description: `mcp.test` payload: one draft server (not persisted; no global session).

server.description: Draft server config (validated by the host before probing).

McpServerConfig.description:
Client-side MCP server configuration (non-secret; ADR-060).

Delivered by the connector catalog / local settings; the client spawns `command` (stdio) or POSTs to `url` (http/sse). Static secrets are rejected by validation (`env` keys must not look like credentials); OAuth tokens stay in the OS keychain.

args.description: Verbatim argv for stdio (no shell concatenation).

command.description: Executable for `transport = "stdio"` (no shell; args are passed verbatim).

env.description: Allow-listed environment for the child process (no static secrets).

id.description: Connector id (stable, used by tools as `server` argument).

oauth_required.description:
Whether this server requires an OAuth bearer token (client-side keychain).

Set from the catalog's public-client metadata; the transport injects `Authorization: Bearer <token>` only when a token was installed by the client OAuth flow and fails honestly with `MCP_OAUTH_REQUIRED` otherwise.

timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (0 or absent => default 10s).

url.description: HTTP(S) endpoint for `transport = "http"` / `"sse"`. Plain `http://` is accepted only for loopback/dev hosts (threat model, docs/07 §6.2); non-loopback requires `https://`.
